title: Amenities — what the guest gets across the whole property
body:
You open the amenities screen on the Modules (Modules) tab, with the **„Setting”** link next to the "What you offer (amenities)"
module. Here you tick what the guest gets across the whole property —
the guest sees this as a clear list on your website.

![Screenshot: the amenities screen on a phone](assets/hu/screen.png)

## What is where on the screen?

The screen's title is the module name, above it the **„Back to modules”** link, and below the title the module fee and the
**„Guide to this screen”** button. Below the introduction there is a row of small buttons with the group names
("Internet, entertainment", "Kitchen, dining", "Bathroom, comfort" and the rest): this row stays at the top of the
screen while you scroll, tapping a button jumps the page to that group, and the button of the
group you are currently in is always highlighted. On a computer the same list is on the right-hand side,
under the heading **„On this page”**. Further down, every group is a pale block with its own heading; the tiles are inside these blocks.

## How do you choose?

Tap the tiles with icons — mark whatever is true for your property; the tile shows the selection
with colour. The items follow each other in categories (internet, kitchen, wellness,
outdoors and the rest), 70 selectable items in total.

The search is quicker: type what you are looking for (e.g. "pool" or "jetty"), and only the matching
tiles stay on the list. The selected items are also shown at the top, on small tags — tap a tag's
**×** to switch it off, without scrolling.

Anything that is not on the list you can type into the **„Other, not on the list”** field, one per line.
The guest sees the listed items in the website's language; free text appears exactly as you type it.

## What belongs here, and what belongs to the rooms?

This screen applies to the **whole property** (e.g. pool, garden, parking, breakfast).
What is true for a single room (e.g. private bathroom, balcony) you mark in the **Rooms, apartments** module,
on that room's card — there your property-level items appear as pale tiles,
because the room inherits them automatically. That is why an item can only be selected in one of the two places:
so the two lists can never contradict each other.

## Saving and restoring

Save the list with the **„Save settings”** button — your website is then updated. If you change
your mind, the **„Back to previous”** button restores the previous saved state.
